agentIntegrations.catalogDescription: Manage the Agents you can chat with in Kun: install, sign in, and connect.
agentIntegrations.catalogError: Could not refresh the agent catalog. You can retry.
agentIntegrations.noMatches: No agents or applications match this search.
agentIntegrations.applicationExplanation: Open this application and manage its own configuration. Chat stays in the application's interface.
agentIntegrations.missingApplication: Install this application using its official instructions, then check again.
agentIntegrations.applicationPathHint: Enter the exact path of an installed client, such as a .app bundle, .exe, or Linux launcher. Leave it blank to use automatic detection. Saving checks the location without opening the application.
agentIntegrations.applicationPathSaveFailed: Could not save and check this application path. Try again.
agentIntegrations.configurationHint: These locations belong to the integration. Open an existing file or folder to review its configuration.
agentIntegrations.configurationEmpty: This integration does not list configuration locations for this platform.
agentIntegrations.locationsError: Could not load configuration locations. Try again.
agentIntegrations.openError: Could not open this location. Try again.
agentIntegrations.desktopOnly: Opening local applications and files requires the desktop app.
agentIntegrations.terminalExplanation: Enable this agent to launch its interactive CLI in Kun's terminal. Its own interface manages the conversation.
agentIntegrations.terminalModelManaged: Select the native model in the CLI itself. Kun does not advertise a native model catalog for this terminal integration.
agentIntegrations.terminalOpenHint: Enable and verify this agent before opening a terminal.
